question: For each terminal or major governance blocker of R8, R9, R10 and Causa (plus R4), would a pre-T0 dry run of the governance pipeline on the exact frozen package and lock have failed with an error matching the historical blocker?
hypothesis: H1: the dry run catches > 50% of replayable blockers. H2: it catches mechanical blockers (format, tool/plan, binding, time budget) and misses semantic package defects (R8 command body, INV-04 vs SM-SAVE) and the Causa T18<->T20 cycle under declared-edge checks. H3: catching checks pass on the later fixed artefacts.
independentVars: artefact version: pre-T0 vs later fixed
check variant (D4 V1/V2/V3; D5 preregistered vs project-id; D6 estimator)
dependentVars: tool exit code and refusal text
comparison: Each check's failure text vs the historical blocker's mechanism (Track B events.jsonl); same check on the later fixed artefacts as false-positive control.
tools: harness/dryrun (Python 3, functional): D4 Tarjan SCC, D5 binding, D6 budgets from Track A ci-steps.csv/ci-jobs.csv
environment: 4-vCPU shared sprint host (load avg 11-20 from other tracks), Linux, .NET SDK 10.0.402 at /root/.dotnet, Python 3, Node 22; scratch under /home/user/sprint-scratch/B2; source repositories only read (git archive / local clone).
procedure: Preregister protocols/SPR-B2-01.md (commit c7088f8) before any check runs.
Freeze inputs: last pre-T0 Indy-init commit or the run's recorded governing commit; T0 bootstrap commit as the throwaway repo.
Run D1-D7 per blocker (python3 -m dryrun.main causa approvals r10 suites r8sem), each writing raw/<KEY>.json with tool output.
Rerun each catching check on later fixed artefacts.
python3 -m dryrun.summarize -> results.csv and catch rates.
verification: Full clean end-to-end rerun reproduced all 11 outcomes (raw/full-rerun-timing.txt). 14 unittest tests pass (harness/tests: pure checks + consistency over raw records). R10-AUTH cause set compared line-by-line to the historical refused log (55/55 identical).
limitations: Dry-run repositories are the runs' own T0 bootstrap/setup commits (timestamps 2-10 min after T0, but no application code and determined by pre-T0 inputs), not repositories bootstrapped by me before T0.

R10-AUTH needed one relocation: the committed suite-preflight report names the R10 checkout path; its root field was rewritten to the scratch path (unrelocated run kept: 56 causes = 55 historical + 1 path-only).
Praxis 3.25.0 was built from source because the release-installer download was refused by the session permission classifier.
D6 estimator (success-only per-kind maxima) was fixed after a first run in which cancelled R6 steps dominated; outcome is estimator-sensitive.
D5 as preregistered also fails on the fixed rules (causa-t0 vs repo name causa); the discriminating variant uses the bootstrap Praxis project id and is post hoc.
D4 V2/V3 were preregistered; the mechanism-match rule (T18->T20 edge required, giant SCC treated as unrelated) was applied after seeing a 27-slice SCC.
R10-GATE: only the time-budget cause is replayable; write-once record, install timeouts, branch-name refusal and cancellations need hosted Actions.
Stub suites select zero tests, so stub runs cannot measure suite duration; time budgets rely on historical data.
conclusion: Catch rate 4/8 (0.50) on the brief's blocker list, 5/9 with R4, 7/11 on the extended list. Robust, discriminating catches: R4 and R8 approvals, R8 and R9 MSB1008/undefined webkit, R10 authorize-implementation (55/55 causes). CAUSA-RULES caught but the preregistered check is non-discriminating; R10-JOBCAP caught only under one estimator. Not caught: R8 command body, R8 INV-04, Causa T18<->T20 cycle, R10 gate deadlock. H1 not supported on the brief list (0.50 is not > 0.5), supported on the extended list; H2 supported; H3 supported except preregistered D5. Cost: under 1 minute of tool time per rehearsal once tools are built (max 45 s, R8); builds 28 s (requirements-compiler + ContractCheck) and 152 s (Praxis).
reproduction: cd harness && python3 -m dryrun.main causa approvals r10 suites r8sem && python3 -m dryrun.summarize && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests  (needs /home/user/sprint-scratch/B2/indy-init-full = full clone of kemiller2002/Indy-init, Praxis 3.25.0 built at /home/user/sprint-scratch/B2/build/praxis-3.25.0 with wrapper bin/praxis, @playwright/test 1.63.0 in /home/user/sprint-scratch/B2/pw)
